summary: Implemented TimeExtension.parse and its deleted _datetime helper in extensions.py, and every stub in generate.py: apply_overwrites_to_context, generate_context with default-context warnings, generate_file with per-file line-ending handling and _new_lines forcing, render_and_create_dir, the deprecated _run_hook_from_repo_dir shim, and generate_files with copy-only paths, undefined-variable cleanup and hook dispatch. The last full-suite run showed 366 passed, 1 failed and 4 skipped; the one failure, tests/test_cli.py::test_echo_undefined_variable_error, comes from main.py context composition (the _cookiecutter and _template/_repo_dir keys), not from my files.
